description: Renovate is OFF. Dependabot (.github/dependabot.yml) owns dependency updates:
it groups every patch+minor across the four workspaces into ONE PR and files
each major on its own. Renovate files one PR per package and does not group,
so running both rebuilt an 11-PR backlog AND filed every major twice.
Kept as `enabled: false` rather than deleted: with no config file at all the
Renovate app falls back to its own defaults and starts filing again.
